what: When the pointer is over the list, a 160px-wide preview window turns on in .5s and follows the cursor .4s late (power3.out), each time the row changes, the new picture slides up from 20% below at -10° tilt over 1s power4.out and straightens in 1s power2.out, while the previous picture exits upward. When the pointer leaves the list it turns off in .5s

options.follow: Duration of following the cursor (s), default .4
options.--fx-width: Window width (css variable — set via the list item style), default 10rem
options.[data-fx-part=row]: Row — attach data-thumb (image URL) or data-label (image description text, placeholder panel). With neither, it shows ‹no image›

use: Your news title here…
note: Does not turn on below 735px or on touch devices
